handoff.salientSummary: Startup completed, but the required baseline mission test command fails before any floor-plan edits due to unrelated pre-existing Vitest import-resolution errors around `server-only` in `libs/resend.ts`. Per worker-base policy, I did not proceed with feature implementation on a broken baseline.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: No product code changes were made for `floor-plan-readonly-shell-and-routing` because the mandatory baseline validation step failed before implementation began. I completed startup/context review, ran the repo init script successfully, confirmed the mission boundaries and target files, and captured the blocking baseline test failure details for orchestrator follow-up.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: The floor-plan shell/routing refactor, test-first updates, validators, manual browser verification, and commit were not started because the baseline `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=9` command failed on pre-existing unrelated suites.

commandsRun.observation: Repo init completed successfully and reported the environment ready for the floor-plan read-only redesign mission.

Baseline mission test command failed before any edits. Two unrelated suites errored: `tests/server/email-queue-route.test.ts` and `tests/server/auth/magic-link-email.test.ts`, both failing to resolve `server-only` from `libs/resend.ts`; the email-queue route suite also reported a hoisted `vi.mock` module-mocking error stemming from that import failure.

tests.coverage: No new or updated tests were added because implementation could not begin after the broken baseline was detected.

discoveredIssues.description: Pre-existing: the mission baseline test command `npx vitest run --maxWorkers=9` is failing in unrelated email/auth suites due to `Failed to resolve import "server-only" from "libs/resend.ts"`, which blocks feature work under worker-base policy.
discoveredIssues.suggestedFix: Restore/alias the `server-only` dependency for Vitest or adjust the affected tests/mocks so `libs/resend.ts` can be imported in the test environment, then rerun the baseline before reassigning this floor-plan feature.
